title: a dive into spanish history
text:
The guide revealed a deep knowledge about the subject of the visit. He was just SUPER!
very kind and open to questions
author: Armando_S

title: Valuable learning experience
text: Very full of important information. The use of an audio phone helped. The Archivo is a large building and it was unclear if there were available restrooms. Our guide was very helpful and interactive.
author: Kathleen_F

title: Details from past explorations come to life
text: The Archives tell so much of a story about Isabella,  Sevilla and the New World. The building is a story in itself and the details about the voyages to the "Indies" are stunning.
author: Laura_A

title: Must visit
text: The guide was great, knew a lot and the visit was very entertaining. Details based on historical evidence.
author: Marialuz_C

title: An essential experience!
text: Unbeatable!! A very interesting and complete visit, also very rigorous and surprisingly enjoyable. Ruben’s (our guide) ability to convey what life was like at the time and how that translates to the different elements of the visit is incredible (both outside and inside the building). I am from Seville, and I would recommend it as essential both to Sevillens and people from outside. Thank you very much for the experience!
author: plopetass

title: An enjoyable and interesting immersion in an entire era
text: Spectacular experience. The visit was super complete, kept you 2 hours with total interest. It was noticeable that the guide was a highly trained person and that he had prepared the route with great interest, giving interesting and enjoyable information. It is curious that a visit to a single building allows you to get an idea of a whole historical stage. Super recommended!
author: P7315MKbeatrizs

title: EXCELLENT
text: Rubén took us into the fascinating History of the Archive of the Indies, with stories full of passion and mastery, he kept us in suspense for almost two hours. A 10 for the organization, the preparation, and the way of telling things so pleasantly, with wisdom and professionalism. How we enjoyed!! We will repeat 100% THANK YOU!
author: 783asistented

title: Cultural visit to immerse yourself and enjoy.
text: Highly recommended! There is a historical context that immerses you in each moment of the story that is told around the archive.
author: carolinav294

title: Exceptional guide saved the lacking current exhibition /. Exceptional guide saved the sparse current exhibition.
text:
The tour of the Archivo de Indias was exceptional. While the current exhibition is lacking, the guide did a tremendous job recreating the history to make the experience highly enjoyable.
